podcast.title: Hearing Concerns Inspire In-Ear Monitor Invention
podcast.body: As the drummer for Van Halen, Alex Van Halen expressed concerns that the "constant on-stage volume was killing his hearing." His complaints were the direct impetus for the band's sound engineer, Jerry Harvey, to innovate and create the first in-ear monitors to protect musicians' hearing and improve their on-stage experience. "When drummer Alex Van Halen started to complain that the constant on-stage volume was killing his hearing, Jerry decided to do something about it."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Catalyst for In-Ear Monitor Invention
xref.body: Van Halen played a crucial role in the development of in-ear monitors. Their sound engineer, Jerry Harvey, invented the technology after drummer Alex Van Halen complained that the "constant on-stage volume was killing his hearing." "The inventor was a guy named Jerry Harvey, a sound engineer who worked with Van Halen."

xref.title: Playing with Family
xref.body: Wolfgang Van Halen has played bass in his father Eddie Van Halen's and uncle Alex Van Halen's band for many years. "Wolfgang Van Halen has been playing bass in his dad and uncle's band for years."
